Write and run the RevBayes scripts of the 114 models: 3 alignment strategies, the datasets of `data/processed/nexus/` (`all` and `bounds` with `full` or `recent` historical records, and `extant_none`, the song types of the last year without historical records) and 2 clock models (`global` and `relaxed`).

Model names follow the nexus files: `<lek>_<strategy>_<dataset>_<historical>_<clock>` (e.g. `BR1_optimal_bounds_recent_relaxed`) (`<dataset>_<historical>` is `extant_none` for the models without historical records, e.g. `TR1_prank_extant_none_global`). The taxon files (`data/processed/taxa/`) are written by `scripts/write_nexus.R`. The Rev scripts are written to `scripts/models/` and the results to `output/revbayes/`.

The previous version of this file, with the names of the first version of the study, is in the git history.

# Models with historical records (fossilized birth-death)

```{r revbayes models with historical records, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}

nexus_dir <- "./data/processed/nexus"
taxa_dir <- "./data/processed/taxa"
model_dir <- "./scripts/models"
out_dir <- "./output/revbayes"
dir.create(model_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

nex <- list.files(nexus_dir, pattern = "_(all|bounds)_(full|recent)_alignment\\.nex$")
grd <- expand.grid(data = sub("_alignment\\.nex$", "", nex), clock = c("global", "relaxed"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
grd$lek <- sub("_.*", "", grd$data)
grd$set <- sub("^[A-Z0-9]+_[a-z]+_", "", grd$data)
grd$output <- paste(grd$data, grd$clock, sep = "_")

# skip models with results
done <- unique(sub("_[0-9]{6}_posterior\\.var$", "", list.files(out_dir, pattern = "posterior\\.var$")))
grd <- grd[!grd$output %in% done, , drop = FALSE]

for (x in seq_len(nrow(grd))) {
  taxa_file <- file.path(taxa_dir, paste0(grd$lek[x], "_", grd$set[x], "_taxa.tsv"))

  # songs of the last year of sampling
  taxa <- read.delim(taxa_file)
  last_year <- paste0("clade(", paste0('"', taxa$taxon[taxa$age == 0], '"', collapse = ", "), ")")

  templ <- readLines("./scripts/template.Rev")
  templ[1] <- gsub("aligment.name", file.path(nexus_dir, paste0(grd$data[x], "_alignment.nex")), templ[1])
  templ[2] <- gsub("tsv.file", taxa_file, templ[2])
  templ[4] <- gsub("output.base.name", file.path(out_dir, grd$output[x]), templ[4])
  templ[10] <- gsub("LAST.SONG.TYPES", last_year, templ[10])
  templ[12] <- sprintf('source("./scripts/control_fbd_%s.Rev")', grd$clock[x])

  rev_file <- file.path(model_dir, paste0(grd$output[x], ".Rev"))
  writeLines(templ, con = rev_file)

  system(paste("mpirun -np 10 ~/revbayes-master/projects/cmake/rb-mpi", rev_file))
  print(paste(grd$output[x], "done,", nrow(grd) - x, "models left"))
}

```

# Models without historical records (birth-death)

```{r revbayes models without historical records, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}

nexus_dir <- "./data/processed/nexus"
taxa_dir <- "./data/processed/taxa"
model_dir <- "./scripts/models"
out_dir <- "./output/revbayes"
dir.create(model_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

nex <- list.files(nexus_dir, pattern = "_extant_none_alignment\\.nex$")
grd <- expand.grid(data = sub("_alignment\\.nex$", "", nex), clock = c("global", "relaxed"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
grd$lek <- sub("_.*", "", grd$data)
grd$output <- paste(grd$data, grd$clock, sep = "_")

done <- unique(sub("_[0-9]{6}_posterior\\.var$", "", list.files(out_dir, pattern = "posterior\\.var$")))
grd <- grd[!grd$output %in% done, , drop = FALSE]

for (x in seq_len(nrow(grd))) {
  taxa_file <- file.path(taxa_dir, paste0(grd$lek[x], "_extant_none_taxa.tsv"))
  taxa <- read.delim(taxa_file)
  last_year <- paste0("clade(", paste0('"', taxa$taxon, '"', collapse = ", "), ")")

  templ <- readLines("./scripts/template.Rev")
  templ[1] <- gsub("aligment.name", file.path(nexus_dir, paste0(grd$data[x], "_alignment.nex")), templ[1])
  templ[2] <- gsub("tsv.file", taxa_file, templ[2])
  templ[4] <- gsub("output.base.name", file.path(out_dir, grd$output[x]), templ[4])
  templ[10] <- gsub("LAST.SONG.TYPES", last_year, templ[10])
  templ[12] <- sprintf('source("./scripts/none/control_bd_%s.Rev")', grd$clock[x])

  rev_file <- file.path(model_dir, paste0(grd$output[x], ".Rev"))
  writeLines(templ, con = rev_file)

  system(paste("mpirun -np 10 ~/revbayes-master/projects/cmake/rb-mpi", rev_file))
  print(paste(grd$output[x], "done,", nrow(grd) - x, "models left"))
}

```

# Keep the most recent run of each model

```{r move results to another folder, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}

posteriors <- list.files(pattern = "posterior\\.var$", path = "./output/revbayes", full.names = TRUE)

# model name and run ID (6 digits) of each run
post_df <- data.frame(full_name = posteriors,
                      model = sub("_[0-9]{6}_posterior\\.var$", "", basename(posteriors)),
                      model_id = sub("^.*_([0-9]{6})_posterior\\.var$", "\\1", basename(posteriors)),
                      mtime = file.info(posteriors)$mtime)

# keep only the most recent one for each model
last_models <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(post_df, post_df$model), function(Y) Y[which.max(Y$mtime), , drop = FALSE]))

files_to_copy <- list.files(pattern = paste(last_models$model_id, collapse = "|"), path = "./output/revbayes",
                            full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)

dir.create("./output/most_recent_revbayes_models", showWarnings = FALSE)
copy_res <- file.copy(from = files_to_copy, to = file.path("./output/most_recent_revbayes_models", basename(files_to_copy)),
                      overwrite = TRUE)

sum(copy_res)

```
